expectations.text: Says no: DFARS 252.204-7012 safeguarding and 72-hour DIBNET incident reporting remain fully enforceable
expectations.evidence: "DFARS 252.204-7012 (safeguarding CUI, 72-hour DIBNET incident reporting)... remain in force"

expectations.text: States the continuing self-assessment machinery: DFARS 7019 Basic Assessments posted to SPRS and 7020 obligations continue
expectations.evidence: "7019 (NIST SP 800-171 self-assessment), 7020 (SPRS score submission)... All of those remain in force"; "annual SPRS submission... obligations continue unchanged"

expectations.text: Notes annual affirmations continue with False Claims Act exposure for misrepresentation
expectations.evidence: "senior-official affirmation obligations continue unchanged. A stale or inaccurate affirmation carries False Claims Act exposure"

expectations.text: States that during the pause DoD enforces via self-assessments AND select government-led assessments
expectations.evidence: Self-assessment track continues ("Self-assessment did not go away... the only track") and "DoD retains audit rights over self-assessments" (government-led assessment authority)

expectations.text: Frames the suspension correctly: Phase 2's C3PAO-as-contract-prerequisite is suspended, not the underlying security requirements; 32 CFR Part 170 remains on the books
expectations.evidence: "the suspension is a pause on how you'll be assessed, not what you must implement"; "that suspension did not touch 32 CFR Part 170"
